Advertisement for Faculty
Thursday, 02 March 2017
7491 Hits
Applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience certificates/testimonials are invited for the following posts for the department of Radiotherapy which must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by 15/03/2017. The appointments would be adhoc till the next Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Associate Professor
:
1
Assistant Professor
:
2
Medical Physicist : 1
Medical Pysicist cum RSO : 1
Qualification:
For posts 1 and 2:
MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
For posts 3 and 4:
Should be M.Sc. Medical Physics from a recognized Indian University and posses outstanding academic record and should have experience of having in the Radiotherapy Department in a Medical College for at least three years and additional for 4- he should have an R.S.O. Certificate (Optional).
Experience   :
As per MCI & MUHS norms
PAY SCALE  :
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
